feed.title: awesome-free-ai-coding — what changed
feed.subtitle: Free LLM APIs and coding agents arriving, changing and dying, as the probes that run twice a week see it.

entry.title: Added: CodeAnt AI
entry.summary: Installed CLI for AI pull-request review and suggested fixes on existing code, with a no-card introductory trial

entry.title: Added: CodeRabbit
entry.summary: Code reviews for local Git changes through an installed CLI or VS Code extension, with an ongoing Free plan alongside a separate introductory trial

entry.title: Added: cubic
entry.summary: AI reviews for existing repositories, with an ongoing Free PR allowance and an included model for interactive local CLI reviews during alpha

entry.title: Added: Greptile
entry.summary: AI pull-request reviews on existing repositories with recurring Starter credits; installed CLI reviews use a separate no-card trial or a paid plan

entry.title: Archived: Poolside Platform
entry.summary: vendor-announced shutdown on 2026-10-31
